title: soc2-prep-scratchpad-olivia-martinez
content:
SOC2 prep scratchpad - Olivia M

Objective:
- Capture open questions, quick evidence sources, and action items for upcoming SOC2 readiness review (internal dry run).
- Prioritize controls that are high-risk / high-effort: access reviews, change mgmt for serving-runtime, backup/restore for Dedicated nodes, kms/hsm evidence for Private builds.

High-level control mapping (first pass):
- Security (common): MFA enforced + SSO (Okta) -> evidence: Okta org export, SSO configs, MFA enforcement policy. Owner: Ryan C.
- Access reviews: quarterly role review + IAM role inventory -> evidence: IAM export csv, Slack audit logs for deprovision notifications. Owner: Lena M.
- Change management (infra & serving-runtime): PR + rollout approvals for model-serving infra -> evidence: GitHub PRs, changelog, release-runbook. Owner: Eng PM / Release Eng (TBD).
- Logging & monitoring: centralized logs (Stackdriver/Datadog), retention policy (90d), alerting for anomalous spikes -> evidence: dashboards + retention policy doc. Owner: SRE (Zoe K.).
- Backup & restore (Dedicated + Private): snapshot schedule + restore test results -> evidence: snapshot schedules, last restore test (date + results). Owner: Infra Eng.
- Encryption: at-rest (KMS/HSM) and in-transit (TLS) for hosted & private -> evidence: KMS key list, CMK usage, TLS certs inventory. Owner: Security Ops.
- Vendor mgmt: subprocessor list and contracts -> evidence: legal redacted contracts, vendor questionnaire. Owner: Legal/Compliance.

Open questions / TODOs (explicit):
- (Q1) Need formal owner for change mgmt for model weights / model onboarding. Is this Product or Research? -> Assign by 2025-02-25.
- (Q2) Backup retention for Dedicated: do we treat customer-reserved instances differently? Document differences (Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private).
- (Q3) Evidence location: create a single confluence page with links to exported artifacts (do not include secrets). Agree on naming convention for exported files.
- (Q4) Can we automate IAM export on a daily cron to an audit bucket (read-only for compliance)? Ticket: JIRA-SOC2-58 (create automation).

Evidence checklist (quick scan):
- Okta org export snapshot -> have (2024-12-05) [need to re-export for dry run].
- MFA enforcement screenshot -> have.
- IAM role inventory csv -> partial (missing retired roles). ACTION: ask infra for complete list.
- GitHub PR approvals for last 3 months -> pick PRs: infra PRs linked (see linked_artifacts).
- Release runbooks (canary + rollback steps) -> draft exists in Confluence; need final sign-off.
- Backup snapshot schedule & last restore test -> missing restore test doc. Plan restore test by 2025-02-28.
- KMS key list + rotation policy -> ask Security Ops for rotation proof.

Quick wins (low lift):
- Export SSO/MFA screenshots and put into confluence page (Olivia to do by 2025-02-20).
- Pull last 90 days of SRE alert history and attach to evidence page (Zoe).
- Create a single folder in audit-bucket 'soc2-evidence/dry-run-2025-02' and grant read access to auditors (secops+legal).

Risk notes / things to call out to execs:
- Model change mgmt is ambiguous: models are not just code: weights, tokenizers, quantization profiles change behavior. Need explicit process and owners for "model onboarding" and "model rollout".
- Dedicated customer incidents: need clarity on who owns incident communications when Dedicated <-> Redwood infra interplay.
- Private deployments (air-gapped): evidence is customer-controlled; we need a segregation table outlining what Redwood can reasonably provide.

Meeting notes (2025-02-10 dry run prep sync):
- Maya: recommended we separate controls into Org-level vs Product-level owners.
- Ryan: suggested automating IAM export + weekly access review reminder.
- Lena: will own quarterly access review checklist; will draft template.
- Zoe: will pull logging retention configs and confirm retention spans for all envs.

Action items (owner -> task -> due):
- Olivia -> create confluence evidence page + initial uploads -> 2025-02-20.
- Ryan -> Okta export + MFA screenshots -> 2025-02-18.
- Lena -> Draft access review template -> 2025-02-22.
- Zoe -> Logs + retention export -> 2025-02-21.
- Infra Eng -> Schedule/perform restore test -> 2025-02-28 (ticket JIRA-SOC2-42).
- Security Ops -> KMS rotation proof + key inventory -> 2025-03-05.

Notes to self:
- Keep artifacts names stable: soc2-2025/<control>-<date>-<owner>.zip.
- Don't include private keys or any PEM files in confluence; reference audit-bucket refs instead.
- For Dedicated evidence, ask account owners for customer-facing docs that describe reserved-capacity configs.

Potential blockers:
- Legal redactions for vendor contracts (may delay vendor evidence).
- Restore test coordination across timezones (need SRE weekend window).

Longer-term improvements (post-audit):
- Automate periodic evidence exports to audit-bucket (encrypt-at-rest, immutable retention).
- Build simple "evidence tracker" spreadsheet that maps controls -> artifacts -> last_updated -> owner -> jira_ticket.

Random thoughts / brainstorm (fragile, keep):
- Could we instrument a nightly job to snapshot critical infra state (IAM, Okta, KMS usage, audit logs) and store as signed artifact? Would simplify audits but consider cost + retention.
- For model rollout, add a short form that documents model inputs, expected behavior change, evaluation prompts, and rollback criteria (keep with release docs).

End of scratchpad.

-- Olivia M.
